clips.title: The story
paras: Dwarven crews blast into the red earth at Bael Modan, searching for Titan relics. Their fortified outpost has driven the Stonespire tauren from their sacred land and kindled a bitter fight.

Bael Modan's walls guard Bael'dun Keep, siege cannons, gyrocopter landing pads, and a deep excavation pit. Dwarven prospectors came to Kalimdor convinced an ancient Titan facility lay beneath the red earth. Their blasting tore through sacred ground of the Stonespire tauren. The expedition answered no call to negotiate. Gunfire and explosives drove the tribe from its ancestral lands, leaving survivors scattered and vengeful.
